### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **23** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/builtin-capabilities.ts`, `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via sys_capability (literal, a string literal in bootstrapSystemCapabilities), /api/v1/meta/capability (route, a path literal in a comment in start))_
- `content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx`  _(via sys_capability (literal, a string literal in bootstrapSystemCapabilities), /api/v1/meta/capability (route, a path literal in a comment in start))_
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/index.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`  _(via sys_capability (literal, a string literal in bootstrapSystemCapabilities), /api/v1/meta/capability (route, a path literal in a comment in start))_
- `content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`  _(via SYSTEM_CTX (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/plugins/packages.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/implementation-status.mdx`  _(via SecurityPlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via sys_capability (literal, a string literal in bootstrapSystemCapabilities))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via SYSTEM_CTX (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx`  _(via tryFind (symbol, a top-level function))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/builtin-capabilities.ts`, `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **8** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f473bb721047813018e12cfbc68ca6ee66fdf7f0` — the merge of head `b8df7fda7b8fc0205bae7d45995fac7c600cfc95` into base `d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f473bb721047813018e12cfbc68ca6ee66fdf7f0 && git checkout f473bb721047813018e12cfbc68ca6ee66fdf7f0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1 b8df7fda7b8fc0205bae7d45995fac7c600cfc95 && git checkout -B drift-repro d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1 && git merge --no-ff b8df7fda7b8fc0205bae7d45995fac7c600cfc95

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs d7b26df5b50f323dd42d693eea5d7de55922bdd1` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

os-dev-report addendum: landing patch round (6b-1b, ruling 6104498446)

**Merge head `b8df7fda7b`** (`origin/main` `d7b26df5b5` merged in; no rebase, no force-push). **Size against merge base `d7b26df5b`: 2,964 changed lines (+105 / −2,859, 20 files), under 3,000.** GitHub reads the same 105 / 2,859 / 20, and `mergeable: true`.

**Conflict resolutions**
- `bootstrap-system-capabilities.ts`: a modify/delete conflict, because main repointed one import (#22696). **Kept the deletion.**
- `security-plugin.ts` import block: main changed `per-organization-catalog.js` to `organization-scope.js` (6c-prep) and still had the seeder import. **Took main's `organization-scope.js` import and dropped the seeder import.** No other hunk conflicted, and no live reference to `bootstrapSystemCapabilities` or `materializedCapabilityNames` remains. The only remaining mentions are comments in retired modules (batch #310 item 4) and the historical prose in `measure-durability-swallow-family.mjs`.
- No path in this PR is `merge=os-regen`, so a plain `git merge` applied. The tenant-audit census and the double-contract baseline were re-checked on the merged tree by their own gates; both exit 0 with no regeneration needed.

**Gate and suite exits** (all at `b8df7fda7b`, every exit captured before any pipe)
- Full build (`turbo run build`, all packages except docs): 72 of 72 tasks, exit 0.
- Typecheck: plugin-security, lint and spec each exit 0, including `check:test-typecheck`.
- Suites:
  - `plugin-security`: 197 files, **4053 passed** / 45 skipped.
  - `lint`: 135 files, 6321 passed.
  - `spec`: 697 files, 20175 passed / 1 todo.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 121 commands; all 121 exit 0. `--ran`: 121 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).
- Nothing is still running.

**Each sentence re-verified against `main` after stage 1** (stage 1 edited `authorization.mdx`, `capabilities.mdx`, `permission-sets.mdx` and `validate-capability-references.ts`; nothing it changed falsifies a sentence of this PR, and no fix was needed):
- `permission-sets.mdx:150`: curated capabilities are registry declarations with no row; package-declared ones are seeded as a row. **Holds.** No non-test `sys_capability` read in core, objectql, rest, services, plugin-auth or plugin-sharing; the only writer is `bootstrap-declared-capabilities.ts`.
- `permission-sets.mdx:43`: "matched by capability name". **Holds.**
- `capabilities.mdx:223`: the only production reader of the table is the declared-capability boot seeder. **Holds.** The other plugin-security readers are the Setup nav, the object's lookup providers and the curated-name write gate; they are UI and door code, not production readers in the callout's sense, unchanged from before.
- `authorization.mdx:207`: the derivation is retired. **Holds.**
- `authorization.mdx:546`: the registry bullet. **Holds** (`registerBuiltinCapabilities` is on main).
- `spec/src/security/capabilities.ts:14` and `:21`. **Hold.**
- `lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts:22`: stage 1's +62 lines do not touch it. **Holds.**
- `builtin-capabilities.ts:22`. **Holds.**
- Changeset (`plugin-security` minor, `spec` and `lint` patch): every sentence **holds**. No authorization decision changes; a declared capability is still seeded as a package row until 6b-1c.

The PR stays a draft.

Post-hoc audit after merge. PR #22709 (stage 6b-1b of #15204) was queued on `Clause-②: no` without a contract-tier record although its diff touches `packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` and `packages/lint/src/validate-capability-references.ts` (non-test), so the path limb of the contract gate fired and a PASS was owed before the queue. The queue merged it as `7aa8d51c0ffb` at 2026-10-11T03:16:16Z. This record judges, after the fact, whether the declaration was true and whether the changesets match what was published. Inputs: the PR body and file list, its net diff (20 files, +105/−2,859), the check-runs on the head, card #15204 (ACCEPT 6101036695, amendment 6098440046, ruling 6104498446, landing note 6104756315, Landed 6104947165) and the dev report 6100594613 with addenda 6100651013, 6100820807, 6104745893. It touches no `.describe()` (`:169`–`:184`), no export (`:25`, `:40`, `:85`, `:135`, `:197`, `:199`, `:217`), no schema shape and no value in `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` / `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_NAMES`. The four gates that red on a consumed comment all ran `success` on `b8df7fda7b`: "Check generated reference docs are in sync with the spec", "Check the authorable key surface is recorded and nothing vanished", "Check @objectstack/spec public API surface", "Check spec liveness".
